Name: Bullet-Hell Fishing
Author: kaniclub
Description:
[size=5][b]Bullet-Hell Fishing[/b][/size]

Replaces the fishing minigame with a bullet-hell action challenge.
Instead of the standard fishing bar, you catch fish through a custom minigame built around dodging, jumping, and using a barrier.

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Bullet-Hell Fishing replaces Stardew Valley's fishing minigame with a completely different gameplay experience.
You can customize fish behaviors, bullet patterns, coins, obstacles, BGM, and difficulty settings to greatly change how the minigame feels.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Replaces the fishing minigame with a bullet-hell action game
[*]Movement-based gameplay with left/right movement, jump, and barrier
[*]Fish-specific settings and behavior tuning
[*]Easy / Normal / Hard / Hell difficulty modes
[*]Retry prompt after failure
[*]Option to skip the minigame for fish you've already caught
[*]Separate volume settings for BGM and sound effects
[*]Debug launcher for testing and balancing
[*]Behavior customization through JSON definitions
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]SMAPI 4.5.0+
[/list]

[b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu
Lets you change the mod settings in-game.[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.
[*]Download Bullet-Hell Fishing.
[*]Extract the folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.
[*]Launch the game.
[/list]

[b]Example folder structure:[/b]
[code]Mods/
BulletHellFishing/
manifest.json
BulletHellFishing.dll
i18n/
Assets/
[/code]

[b]Source Code[/b]
The source code for this mod is available on GitHub:
